posts.title: K2NET Mengoperasikan AS153992 sebagai Anggota Korporat IDNIC
posts.title_en: K2NET Operates AS153992 as an IDNIC Corporate Member
posts.excerpt: PT Kirana Karina Network mengumumkan operasional BGP mandiri AS153992 (IDNIC-K2NET-ID) untuk layanan ISP di Bandung.
posts.excerpt_en: PT Kirana Karina Network announces independent BGP operations on AS153992 (IDNIC-K2NET-ID) for ISP services in Bandung.
posts.body: K2NET mengoperasikan prefix 165.99.252.0/24 di bawah AS153992 sebagai anggota korporat IDNIC. Langkah ini memperkuat identitas routing mandiri untuk layanan dedicated internet dan managed network.
posts.body_en: K2NET originates 165.99.252.0/24 under AS153992 as an IDNIC corporate member. This strengthens independent routing identity for dedicated internet and managed network services.

posts.title: Layanan Managed IT & Network Operations dari K2NET
posts.title_en: Managed IT & Network Operations from K2NET
posts.excerpt: Selain konektivitas, K2NET mendampingi operasional IT harian: monitoring, firewall, dan dukungan NOC.
posts.excerpt_en: Beyond connectivity, K2NET supports day-to-day IT operations: monitoring, firewall, and NOC support.
posts.body: Sebagai MSP, K2NET membantu klien merancang, mengoperasikan, dan menjaga jaringan kantor — dari dedicated internet hingga keamanan perimeter dan dukungan teknis.
posts.body_en: As an MSP, K2NET helps clients design, operate, and maintain office networks — from dedicated internet to perimeter security and technical support.

posts.title: Jangkauan Layanan K2NET di Bandung dan Jawa Barat
posts.title_en: K2NET Service Coverage in Bandung and West Java
posts.excerpt: Survei last-mile dan aktivasi dedicated internet untuk kawasan Bandung Raya dan kota-kota Jawa Barat.
posts.excerpt_en: Last-mile survey and dedicated internet activation for Greater Bandung and West Java cities.
posts.body: Tim provision K2NET melakukan survei lokasi sebelum aktivasi. Hubungi NOC untuk cek jangkauan di Bandung, Cimahi, dan kawasan Jawa Barat lainnya.
posts.body_en: K2NET provisioning surveys the site before activation. Contact NOC to check coverage in Bandung, Cimahi, and other West Java areas.

posts.title: Dukungan NOC K2NET untuk Insiden Jaringan
posts.title_en: K2NET NOC Support for Network Incidents
posts.excerpt: Eskalasi gangguan, tiket, dan koordinasi recovery melalui hotline dan WhatsApp NOC.
posts.excerpt_en: Incident escalation, ticketing, and recovery coordination via NOC hotline and WhatsApp.
posts.body: Klien dedicated dan managed services dapat menghubungi NOC K2NET di +62 851-3629-0861 atau info@k2net.id untuk eskalasi gangguan dan permintaan perubahan.
posts.body_en: Dedicated and managed-service clients can reach K2NET NOC at +62 851-3629-0861 or info@k2net.id for incident escalation and change requests.

posts.title: Jadwal Maintenance Backbone K2NET
posts.excerpt: Pemberitahuan jendela maintenance terjadwal untuk upgrade kapasitas backbone regional.
posts.excerpt_en: Scheduled maintenance window notice for regional backbone capacity upgrades.
posts.body: NOC K2NET akan menginformasikan jadwal maintenance backbone melalui kanal resmi sebelum aktivitas upgrade dilakukan.
posts.body_en: K2NET NOC will announce backbone maintenance schedules through official channels before upgrade activities.
